name: RZ Intelligent Media Management Tool
author: rz.jhMark

sections.description:
RZ Intelligent Media Management Tool helps you keep your media library clean and efficient. It scans for unused images (those not referenced in any post, page, custom field, or gallery) and duplicate images (based on file hash). You can then delete them in bulk, with safety limits in the free version.

Features:
– Scan unused images
– Scan duplicate images
– Batch delete (up to 3 items per day in free version)
– Handles large media libraries with paged processing
– Low memory footprint
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to the “RZ Media Tool” menu in the admin sidebar to start scanning.
sections.faq:
How does it detect unused images?

It checks all post content (including Gutenberg blocks), postmeta (including ACF and serialized data), and featured thumbnails. Any image ID not found in these places is considered unused.

Can I delete multiple images at once?

Yes, but the free version limits batch deletion to 3 items per day. Upgrade to pro for unlimited deletions.
